final_objective.what_system_does: SuperEzio Financeiro runs a local financial cockpit and Bob pipeline that can analyze finance requests, submit guarded IBKR paper orders, journal paper trades, learn from closed outcomes, and generate a debut report.

final_objective.main_user_flow: Start the local stack, open the cockpit at http://127.0.0.1:8002, ask Bob for an analysis, allow only paper-order flow through KillSwitch, ApprovalGate, and PositionSizer, then review PaperJournal, learning loop, and debut report.

what_was_done: Integrated KillSwitch before every paper submit path and added UTC daily reset support.
Integrated ApprovalGate with auto-approval at risk <= 200 USD, pending approval above 200 USD, cockpit summary exposure, and approve/reject endpoints.
Integrated PositionSizer before paper submit with max 10 percent equity per position and max 2 percent risk per trade.
Added DailyCycle with morning, trading-session, and evening routines for the paper-trading operating loop.
Added C6 aged-thesis review in PaperJournal: after 14 days it compares thesis vs outcome, writes automated post-mortem, tags thesis_closed, and records conversation memory.
Hardened the real FeedbackLoop for C7 with bias analysis over 10+ closed trades, Bob confidence parsing, calibration gap detection, and Bob context injection.
Added scripts/debut_report.py for C1-C8 report, performance summary, bias section, and readiness recommendation.
Ran live local validation with restarted stack and browser smoke.
